about: The sea slug species' own ID marks: agent drafts until Pierre validates them (Pierre, 2026-11-19: "Il faut sourcer tous les … qu'on peut … Surtout si ça peut aider notre app"; "Il faudra l'amener au niveau des espèces"), as the fish species' (tools/fish_species_marks.json). For every species of seaslug.json: 1 to 3 marks that tell it from the other species of its genus in the game by eye on a photo (colour pattern included: for a nudibranch it is often the species' mark), in our own words, short (at most 80 characters), with no number (a count is never a photo cue); a species named in a mark is one of its genus's species in the tree (rules C3, C6). Written from public pages read on 2026-11-19: SEASLUG.WORLD species pages (sw-, the page slug: their Description and Remarks, the colours in life only) and Sea Slug Forum fact sheets (ssf-, the sheet's code). src: each source {t, u}, t starting with the source's short name before its first comma. species, by the scientific name seaslug.json shows: marks, each [words, refs], a ref [src key, the words of the page it rests on, verbatim: each was checked by script against the page text as read, and the page's own title names the species]. none: a species left without marks and why, never a mark guessed. draft: true while Pierre has not validated them: the build marks every species' marks as a draft (seaslug.json mdraft), which the species sheet says. tools/seaslug_cues.py species_apply (through tools/seaslug_game.py) puts marks, msrc, mby and mdraft on seaslug.json species and stops on anything else; learn.js marksBox shows them on the species sheet as it shows a genus's.
